title: MirrorMind
tagline: Clone yourself as an AI agent that think like you. Verified by digital identity, powered by uAgents.
description: MirrorMind is a platform for building AI agents that act as digital versions of individuals or tailored assistants. Through blockchain-based identity verification and AI training, users create agents that represent their knowledge and monetize conversations with others on the network. Vision: Empower anyone to scale their presence through verified AI clones that maintain their unique personality and expertise. Mission: Provide a secure system where creators, experts, and public figures can build and monetize trusted AI agents while keeping ownership of their identity and data. Goals and Features: Identity-backed cloning – users verify their identity on the blockchain and upload knowledge to create a personal agent. Custom assistants – non-clone agents can be configured for specific topics, each with a unique ID. Monetization – conversations with agents generate revenue for their owners via the AgentRegistry smart contract. User onboarding – a conversational flow collects relevant information to initialize the agent’s language model. Marketplace – discover and interact with verified agents from creators and specialists.
how_its_made:
Artificial Superintelligence Alliance We build on Fetch.ai's uAgents, hosting through Agentverse, and make agents discoverable via ASI:One. This aligns our project with the ASI Alliance challenge, which rewards the best autonomous agent built on this stack.

Privy MirrorMind integrates Privy to provide embedded wallets and simple crypto onboarding, allowing non-technical users to interact with our blockchain-backed agents.

Self Protocol We use the Self.xyz SDK for zero-knowledge identity proofs on the Celo network. Users can verify country and age data without exposing personal details, satisfying hackathon requirements for Self Protocol prizes.
